title: Valley of Flowers
summary: September in the Valley of Flowers: meadows in bloom, waterfalls, and cloud sitting low on every ridge.

waterfall-01.avif.caption: A waterfall out of the cloud
waterfall-01.avif.alt: A thin waterfall threads down a steep green mountainside, its top lost in thick cloud

camp-01.avif.caption: Camp below the cloud
camp-01.avif.alt: Rows of white and green tents on a grassy slope below a forested mountain wrapped in cloud

pink-balsam-01.avif.caption: Wild balsam after the rain
pink-balsam-01.avif.alt: Pink balsam flowers with raindrops on their stems among green leaves

rock-wall-01.avif.caption: Under the rock wall
rock-wall-01.avif.alt: A hiker with a backpack stands on a boulder beneath a towering, overhanging rock wall

valley-01.avif.caption: Into the Valley of Flowers
valley-01.avif.alt: A meadow of small white flowers leading into a valley between dark cliffs, cloud filling the gap

flower-meadow-01.avif.caption: A seat among the flowers
flower-meadow-01.avif.alt: A person in a checked shirt sits on a rock in a meadow of tall white flowers below misty green hills

cloud-peak-01.avif.caption: Cloud over the peaks
cloud-peak-01.avif.alt: Cloud pours over a dark mountain peak under a grey sky
